summary: Kimbell Royalty Partners filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing that on October 16, 2026 it delivered a redemption notice for 81,250 Series A Cumulative Convertible Preferred Units—half of those outstanding—redeemable November 16, 2026 at $1,233.37895 per unit, an aggregate price of approximately $100.2 million. Funding is expected from revolving credit facility borrowings. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The redemption retires half the preferred overhang but adds balance-sheet leverage; the convertible feature and remaining units are worth watching for future redemption pace and equity dilution risk.
